description: Current project-level main semantic-break pairs kept for BAS-VLA on LIBERO.

pairs.clean_instruction: put both the alphabet soup and the tomato sauce in the basket
pairs.control_instruction: put the alphabet soup and the tomato sauce into the basket
pairs.break_instruction: put both the alphabet soup and the butter in the basket

pairs.clean_instruction: put the yellow and white mug in the microwave and close it
pairs.control_instruction: place the yellow and white mug in the microwave and close it
pairs.break_instruction: close the microwave and put the yellow and white mug in it

pairs.clean_instruction: turn on the stove and put the moka pot on it
pairs.control_instruction: switch on the stove and put the moka pot on it
pairs.break_instruction: turn off the stove and put the moka pot on it
